question.worked_solution:
First, we determine the points where the curve intersects the $x$-axis by solving the following equation for $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}4{x}^{2}-{x}^{3} & =0 \\ {x}^{2}(4-x) & =0\end{aligned}
$$

The solutions are $x=0$ and $x=4.$ So, we need to integrate from $x=0$ to $x=4.$ 

Using the shell method, the volume of the solid can be found as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}V & =2\pi {\int }_{a}^{b}x\,f(x)\,\text{d}x \\  & =2\pi {\int }_{0}^{4}x(4{x}^{2}-{x}^{3})\text{d}x \\  & =2\pi {\int }_{0}^{4}(4{x}^{3}-{x}^{4})\text{d}x \\  & =2\pi {({x}^{4}-\frac{{x}^{5}}{5})|}_{0}^{4} \\  & =2\pi [({4}^{4}-\frac{{4}^{5}}{5})-0] \\  & =2\pi (256-\frac{1024}{5}) \\  & =\frac{512\pi }{5}\end{aligned}
$$
